Account loading UI:
- Loading spinner and status text are centered inside the full-width login/register/refresh button.
- Loading no longer takes external horizontal space or shifts/shrinks the button.
- Busy button stays disabled; the decorative overlay is hidden from accessibility.
- A single helper renders the actual action label for measurement and accessibility.
- Six final-product-package emulator cases passed: registration, login, profile refresh,
  dark registration at 1.3 font scale, login at 1.5 font scale and initial account restoration.
- Each case checks unchanged idle/busy horizontal boundaries, in-button geometry, centered overlay,
  disabled action and noninteractive/accessibility-hidden overlay. Screenshots inspected.
- UI states were injected by same-certificate emulator-only Instrumentation, without submitting
  registration/login, saving a synthetic identity, or using the user's account/password.
- Evidence: .impeccable/review/account-loading-0.9.5/report.json and sibling PNG/log files.

Built-in online library:
- App uses its existing CloudBase public catalog as a product-managed endpoint.
- Settings row, address dialog and Help address entry removed; related help text updated.
- Older custom and explicitly disabled configurations migrate to the built-in endpoint.
- Old custom catalog cache is isolated; local downloaded/imported preset bytes are preserved.
- Unreadable/non-file configuration and atomic write failure close this instance to every endpoint;
  retry after repairing the filesystem can resume. No fallback request to the legacy endpoint.
- Library Java host regression: 231 checks passed, including 55 managed-endpoint migration checks.
- Public catalog GET returned HTTP 200 with zero published presets.
- Final APK emulator directly loaded this real empty catalog without address configuration;
  Settings no longer contained the editor. No sample/preset was fabricated or published for this test.
- Backend not changed or redeployed in this release.
